sentences: Minimization CSPs seek assignments minimizing a specified constraint-violation cost.
The textbook asks whether algorithms can match their semidefinite-programming integrality gaps within an additional factor \(1+\varepsilon\).
An integrality gap measures how much cheaper a fractional or vector solution can appear than any genuine assignment.
Matching that benchmark would show that rounding loses essentially no more than the relaxation itself.
The saved historical note does not identify the exact CSP family, relaxation, or treatment of zero optimum, so these conventions remain necessary before the target becomes a precise uniform theorem.
